units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:2">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> <he>הוציא כ׳</he> he issued a proclamation.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:1">Snh. VI, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:20">43ᵃ</cite>) <he>והכ׳ יוצא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>וכ׳</he>) and it is cried out before him (the delinquent). Ib. 43ᵃ (missing in later ed.) <he>והכ׳ יוצא לפניו וכ׳</he> and forty days before his (Jesus’) execution, it was published &c.; a. fr.
